programmes.d: The girlfriend (Evelyn Keyes) of a frontier doctor (Willard Parker) falls for a member (Larry Parks) of an outlaw clan.
The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).
Bat Masterson (George Montgomery), Doc Holliday (James Griffith) and Wyatt Earp rescue a framed rancher and stop an Indian war.
A cavalry officer and two of his men set out to make sure that a shipment of guns safely reaches its destination.
A cowboy finds himself in serious trouble with a notorious outlaw.
The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) catch up to payroll robbers.
The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) look for stolen gold with a history.
A Confederate colonel (Richard Widmark) makes a cattleman (William Holden) teach his troops how to herd Union cattle.
A Union major (Charlton Heston) chases Indians to Mexico with a condemned Confederate captain (Richard Harris) and a cavalry of prisoners.
A circa-1917 rancher sends mercenaries (Lee Marvin, Burt Lancaster) to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claudia Cardinale) from a Mexican bandit.

programmes.t: The Gun That Won the West
programmes.d: Superior Springfield rifles help scouts (Dennis Morgan, Richard Denning) and the cavalry get forts built in Wyoming.
A stagecoach operator calls on the Durango Kid when an evil rival attempts to drive him out of business.
The conniving Ed Barker murders a rancher and tries to steal the ranch from his widow, Jean Andrews. However, their old friend Cliff Houston appears on the scene to try and save the day.
Framed for a murder he didn't commit, a cowboy hides with a traveling woman as he flees a sheriff and hunts for the real killer.
An undercover U.S. marshal (Randolph Scott) and a crooked rancher follow an outlaw (Forrest Tucker) to stolen gold.
A Texas marshal (James Stewart) and a cavalry officer (Richard Widmark) recover long-held captives from Comanches.
